svg.text: SHEET 2 - EXPLODED ASSEMBLY, CUT LIST and JOINT DETAIL (WOOD 2x4)
NO bottom beam - fall zone open
Assembly: butt beam between posts, fix with angle brackets + lag screws,
add diagonal braces, then wide feet + kick braces, then radar housing + sandbags.
Wood = cheaper + far less light reflection than aluminium (better for camera/radar demo).
DETAIL A - WOOD CORNER JOINT (typ. top 2 corners)
NOTE: Cut ends square (+/-1 mm). Pre-drill pilot holes before lag screws to avoid splitting. Radar face height 2300 mm set by trimming post / shims. Assembly with drill-driver only.
